paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% from the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

Recent news includes reports of a potential OpenAI connection and a US subpoena tied to Project Matador. On August 15, 2026, Stocktwits reported that Fermi LLC shares jumped more than 27% after analysts said reports of OpenAI exploring a data center lease in Ohio could benefit the company. Fermi Cofounder Toby Neugebauer also commented on the market's support for cooperation between him and the company's board.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q report submitted on August 14, 2026, highlighting corporate conversion and Project Matador risks. An 8-K filing on August 13, 2026, disclosed the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, and another 8-K filing on August 13, 2026, disclosed the company's financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. There was one Form 4 filing in the feed.
